---
name: Improve Existing Tests
about: Improve or Update an Existing Property Test
title: "[IMPROVE]"
labels: ''
assignees: ''

---

**Test Name:**
What is the name or description of the test you want to improve/update? (e.g., "Test for the commutativity of addition")

**Improvement or Update Details:**
Describe what changes you want to make to the test. Are you fixing a bug, improving coverage, or refactoring for clarity? Provide as much detail as possible.

**Reason for Change:**
Why should this update be made? (e.g., "The test doesn't cover negative numbers," or "The test no longer works with the latest version of the testing library.")

**Code Example (Optional):**
If you have an updated code example or a proposed change, include it here.

**Additional Context (Optional):**
Any other relevant information or context for the change. This might include links to issue trackers, GitHub discussions, or changes in the underlying libraries that affect the test.
